decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service gained more visibility, moving to a page of its own in 2024, and sits close to the core offer, so its results appear to meet aspirations and give no cause for problemistic search.

The open GIS development framework is only mentioned and has not been promoted further, but it fits the firm's open, extensible strategy and its research capacity, and the firm's slack allows it to carry a product whose results are still uncertain.
The identity service was actively promoted as new and given a page of its own, signalling performance at or above aspiration and integration with the firm's core GIS offerings.

The consulting workshop is newly launched with a page of its own, needs few resources, and supports the firm's established consulting business, so there is no basis yet for judging it below aspiration.
